fullPassage: You hear again and again that some of the greatest composers were misunderstood in their own day. Not everyone could understand the compositions of Beethoven, Brahms, or Stravinsky in their day. The reason for this initial lack of acceptance is unfamiliarity. The musical forms, or ideas expressed within them, were completely new. And yet, this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great. Effective composers have their own ideas. Have you ever seen the classic movie Amadeus? The composer Antonio Salieri is the "host" of this movie; he's depicted as one of the most famous non-great composers — he lived at the time of Mozart and was completely overshadowed by him. Now, Salieri wasn't a bad composer; in fact, he was a very good one. But he wasn't one of the world's great composers because his work wasn't original. What he wrote sounded just like what everyone else was composing at the time.

[ at / composing / else / everyone / the / time / was / what ] (8단어)

det.korean: what everyone else was composing at the time
det.analysis:
'what(관계사) + everyone else(주어) + was composing(과거진행) + at the time(부사구)' 어순.
본문 'sounded just like what everyone else was composing at the time'.

questions.wa: what everyone else was composing at the time
accept: what everyone else was composing at the time

questions.passage: You hear again and again that some of the greatest composers were misunderstood in their own day. Not everyone could understand the compositions of Beethoven, Brahms, or Stravinsky in their day. The reason for this initial lack of acceptance is unfamiliarity. The musical forms, or ideas expressed within them, were completely new. And yet, this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great. Effective composers have their own ideas. Have you ever seen the classic movie Amadeus? The composer Antonio Salieri is the "host" of this movie; he's depicted as __________ — he lived at the time of Mozart and was completely overshadowed by him. Now, Salieri wasn't a bad composer; in fact, he was a very good one. But he wasn't one of the world's great composers because his work wasn't original. What he wrote sounded just like what everyone else was composing at the time.
questions.stem:

"그는 가장 유명한 위대하지-않은 작곡가 중 한 명으로 묘사된다."
He's depicted as __________ — he lived at the time of Mozart.
[조건] (1) composers, famous, most, non-great, of, one, the를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: one of the most famous non-great composers
det.analysis:
'one of the + 최상급(most famous) + 명사(non-great composers)' 구조.
본문 'he's depicted as one of the most famous non-great composers'.

"그리고 바로 이것이 그들을 그토록 위대하게 만드는 것들 중 하나이다."

det.korean: one of the things that makes them so great
det.analysis:
'one of the things(선행사) + that makes them so great(관계절)' 구조.
본문 'this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great'.
관계절의 주어 that(=one)이 단수이므로 makes.
